reader_summary.headline: Kieran spent over two decades at the frontier of credit investing.
reader_summary.overview: Kieran spent over two decades at the frontier of credit investing. During the global financial crisis, he was a Partner and Head of Trading at King Street Capital. He then left to start his own credit hedge fund, Panning Capital Management.

key_points.text: During the global financial crisis, he was a Partner and Head of Trading at King Street Capital.
In our discussion, we cover the state of private credit today, which forms of alpha he’s most skeptical of.
Please enjoy my conversation with Kieran Goodwin.
